reason: The hypothesis directly restates the known effect of substituting Ta with Nb on density and mechanical properties, which is already reported in multiple passages (P6, P10, P13, P18, P22, P24, P27) and is a textbook approach to reducing density in refractory alloys. The mechanism and predicted outcomes are taken almost verbatim from the literature, with no new synthesis or transfer to an unexplored regime.
copied_elements: Replacing Ta with Nb to reduce density
Nb has lower density than Ta
Nb forms stable BCC solid solutions
Yield strength not less than ~800 MPa at 1000 °C
Single-phase BCC structure verification by XRD
